description: This source file defines the SearchProvider class, which manages the state for searching books in a Flutter application. It interacts with a mock API to fetch search results and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: SearchProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class handling book search state, including query string, search results, and loading status. It performs async search operations using a provided API.

methods.description: Asynchronously updates the search query, performs the search using the API, and updates results and loading state accordingly.
